name: V2-60b: fixed v1 + 2B rank-blend ceiling (readout, pre-declared)
purpose: The ceiling a conditions-gated blend (V2-60 design of record, Oct 21) has to beat: fixed-weight rank blends of the shipped v1 rule and the xls-r-2b-anti-deepfake zero-shot column, whose errors are nearly disjoint on the sealed key (docs/reports/2026-10-20_v2-53-benchmark-rows.md section 5).
status: READOUT, NOT A SELECTION. Inner folds are in-sample for the 2B column (DiffSSD, LJ Speech, LibriTTS in its training table), so inner rankings favour it by construction; In-the-Wild is held out for every column but is spent as a selection set (rule 7). No candidate is adopted from this readout. Adoption of any blend or gate waits for V2-24's feature list, the benchmark, and one sealed read at the Phase 6 close. The sealed key is not read here.
